attributes.action: Petition to Confer Honorary Knighthood on J Bellingham for Services to Football
attributes.additional_details: I believe Jude Bellingham has rapidly established himself as one of the most talented and influential footballers in the world. From his exceptional performances at Borussia Dortmund to starring for Real Madrid and the England National Team, his dedication, sportsmanship, and leadership have elevated the profile of British football globally. Due to his pivotal role in leading England to the latter stages of the FIFA World Cup—Bellingham has served as a magnificent role model for the youth.
attributes.background: We, the undersigned, call upon the UK Government and the Honours Committee to officially grant an honorary knighthood to J Bellingham for his outstanding contributions to English football and his inspiring representation of the UK on the global stage during the 2026 world cup.
